title: The Apparent and Partial Molal Volume of Aqueous Sodium Chloride Solutions at Various Temperatures
needs_pass2_reason: text layer scrambled the column order, so the table was transcribed from the page image and cross-checked by a second read against the text-layer numbers; no cell corrections arose
experimental_method: magnetic float densitometer (precision ~1 ppm), weight-dilution and single stock solution methods, 0.01-1.0 m NaCl, 0-55 C
uncertainties_stated: density precision about 1 ppm; bath set to +/-0.02 C, regulated to better than +/-0.001 C
quality_remarks: Table I 0 C, m = 0.684443, 1000(d0-d) printed 40.8267: out of line with neighbours (0.505906 -> 22.0264; 5 C at the same molality gives 28.8041); apparent misprint in the source, kept as printed.
Printed header is -1000(d0 - d); sign as printed; values are positive.
Pressure not stated. PDF pages 3-7 hold text, Table II (apparent molal volume at infinite dilution and deviation constants, derived/fitted) and Table III (association constants, derived).

not_extracted_tables.reason: partial molal volume at infinite dilution and deviation constants: fitted/derived
